author: anon-df5e95db
content: Plan: Write a pure Rust aux_tag_search() function that performs a linear scan through the BAM aux data byte slice to find a 2-byte tag. This replaces htslib::bam_aux_get which does the same thing in C. The function returns a pointer to the type byte (matching bam_aux_get's return convention) so parse_aux_field can be reused unchanged. Three call sites: Record::aux(), Record::remove_aux(), RecordView::aux(). Will add raw_aux_data() helper to Record (already exists on RecordView). Red-green approach: write failing tests first, then implement.
